13843-libretto-la-bohe-me.title: Libretto La Bohe Me
13843-libretto-la-bohe-me.creator: Unknown
13843-libretto-la-bohe-me.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. she has lost her key and whilst they search for it their candles are extinguished. As they grope on the floor in the dark, Rudolph finds the key and puts it in his pocket. Their hands meet and Rudolph tries to warm her hands and tells her all about his life. Mimi confides her struggles to him and their conversation soon turns upon their love for each other.

arxiv-1502-01846.title: A Space weather information service
arxiv-1502-01846.creator: Birgit Ritter*, Arjan J. H. Meskers, Oscar Miles, Michael Rußwurm, Stephen Scully, Andrés Roldán, Oliver Hartkorn, Peter Jüstel, Victor Réville, Sorina Lupu, Alexis Ruffenach
arxiv-1502-01846.description: Abstract The Earth’s magnetosphere is formed as a consequence of interaction between the planet’s magnetic field and the solar wind, a continuous plasma stream from the Sun. A number of different solar wind phenomena have been studied over the past forty years with the intention of understanding and forecasting solar behavior.

arxiv-1510-03272.title: Coordinated Beating of Algal Flagella is Mediated by Basal Coupling Volume: 113
arxiv-1510-03272.creator: Kirsty Y. WanDepartment of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, University of Cambridge, Wilberforce Road, Cambridge CB3 0WA, UK, Raymond E. Goldstein
arxiv-1510-03272.description: Abstract Cilia and flagella often exhibit synchronized behavior; this includes phase-locking, as seen in Chlamydomonas , and metachronal wave formation in the respiratory cilia of higher organisms. Since the observations by Gray and Rothschild of phase synchrony of nearby swimming spermatozoa, it has been a working hypothesis that synchrony arises from hydrodynamic interactions between beating filaments.

arxiv-2208-08795.title: An Adjustable Farthest Point Sampling Method for Approximately-sorted Point Cloud Data
arxiv-2208-08795.creator: Jingtao Li 1 , Jian Zhou 2 , Yan Xiong 1 , Xing Chen 1 , Chaitali Chakrabarti 1
arxiv-2208-08795.description: Abstract Sampling is an essential part of raw point cloud data processing such as in the popular PointNet++ scheme. Farthest Point Sampling (FPS), which iteratively samples the farthest point and performs distance updating, is one of the most popular sampling schemes. Unfortunately it suffers from low efficiency and can become the bottleneck of point cloud applications.

arxiv-2209-14100.title: Observation of robust polarization squeezing via the Kerr nonlinearity in an optical fibre
arxiv-2209-14100.creator: N. Kalinin, T. Dirmeier, A. Sorokin, E. A. Anashkina, L. L. Sánchez-Soto, J. F. Corney, G. Leuchs, A. V. Andrianov
arxiv-2209-14100.description: Abstract Squeezed light is one of the resources of photonic quantum technology. Among the various nonlinear interactions capable of generating squeezing, the optical Kerr effect is particularly easy-to-use. A popular venue is to generate polarization squeezing, which is a special self-referencing variant of two-mode squeezing.

arxiv-2210-15912.title: Decontamination of the scientific literature Journal: Application to the 2022 IUF Chair Programme
arxiv-2210-15912.creator: Guillaume Cabanac
arxiv-2210-15912.description: Abstract Research misconduct and frauds pollute the scientific literature. Honest errors and malevolent data fabrication, image manipulation, journal hijacking, and plagiarism passed peer review unnoticed. Problematic papers deceive readers, authors citing them, and AI-powered literature-based discovery. Flagship publishers accepted hundreds flawed papers despite claiming to enforce peer review.

arxiv-2305-14246.title: Modeling Empathic Similarity in Personal Narratives
arxiv-2305-14246.creator: Jocelyn Shen, Maarten Sap, Pedro Colon-Hernandez, Hae Won Park, Cynthia Breazeal
arxiv-2305-14246.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jocelyn Shen, Maarten Sap, Pedro Colon-Hernandez, Hae Won Park, Cynthia Breazeal. The most meaningful connections between people are often fostered through expression of shared vulnerability and emotional experiences in personal narratives. We introduce a new task of identifying similarity in personal stories based on empathic resonance , i.e., the extent to which two people empathize with each others’ experiences, as opposed to raw semantic or lexical similarity, as has predominantly been studied in NLP.

arxiv-2405-04402.title: Utility-driven Optimization of TTL Cache Hierarchies under Network Delays
arxiv-2405-04402.creator: Karim S. Elsayed * , Fabien Geyer † , Amr Rizk *
arxiv-2405-04402.description: Abstract We optimize hierarchies of Time-to-Live (TTL) caches under random network delays. A TTL cache assigns individual eviction timers to cached objects that are usually refreshed upon a hit where upon a miss the object requires a random time to be fetched from a parent cache.

arxiv-2410-03162.title: Constraining Galaxy-Halo Connection Using Machine Learning Journal: Astronomy & \& Computing
arxiv-2410-03162.creator: Abhishek Jana, Lado Samushia
arxiv-2410-03162.description: Abstract We investigate the potential of machine learning (ML) methods to model small-scale galaxy clustering for constraining Halo Occupation Distribution (HOD) parameters. Our analysis reveals that while many ML algorithms report good statistical fits, they often yield likelihood contours that are significantly biased in both mean values and variances relative to the true model parameters.

arxiv-2506-09050.title: ALE-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Objective-Driven Algorithm Engineering
arxiv-2506-09050.creator: Yuki Imajuku, Kohki Horie, Yoichi Iwata, Kensho Aoki, Naohiro Takahashi, Takuya Akiba
arxiv-2506-09050.description: Abstract How well do AI systems perform in algorithm engineering for hard optimization problems in domains such as package-delivery routing, crew scheduling, factory production planning, and power-grid balancing? We introduce ALE-Bench , a new benchmark for evaluating AI systems on score-based algorithmic programming contests.

plos-pone-0012350.description: PLOS ONE research article. Herpes simplex encephalitis (HSE) is a rare disease with high mortality and significant morbidity among survivors. We have previously shown that susceptibility to HSE was host-strain dependent, as severe, lethal HSE developed after injection of human Herpes simplex type 1 virus (

pmc-10609293.title: On the Jahn–Teller Effect in Silver Complexes of Dimethyl Amino Phenyl Substituted Phthalocyanine †
pmc-10609293.creator: Martin Breza, Adriana Dinescu
pmc-10609293.description: The structures of Ag complexes with dimethyl amino phenyl substituted phthalocyanine m[dmaphPcAg]q of various charges q and in the two lowest spin states m were optimized using the B3LYP method within the D4h symmetry group and its subgroups. The most stable reaction intermediate in the supposed photoinitiation reaction is 3[dmaphPcAg]−.

pmc-10668124.title: Altered gait parameters in distracted walking: a bio-evolutionary and prognostic health perspective on passive listening and active responding during cell phone use
pmc-10668124.creator: Hassan Bazzi, Anthony T. Cacace
pmc-10668124.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The underpinnings of bipedal gait are reviewed from an evolutionary biology and prognostic health perspective to better understand issues and concerns related to cell phone use during ambulation and under conditions of distraction and interference. We also consider gait-related health issues associated with the fear of or risk of falling and include prognostic dimensions associated with cognitive decline, dementia, and mortality.

pmc-11370985.title: Prevalence and Predictors of Domestic Violence in India: Complex Sample Analysis of a Nationally Representative Study Conducted Between 2019 and 2021
pmc-11370985.creator: Sanjeeb K Mishra, Gourahari Pradhan, Subrat K Pradhan, Gitarani Choubey
pmc-11370985.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Violence against women has been one of the dreaded social evils that humanity is facing. There have been concerted efforts to eliminate this evil, and sustainable development goals goal 5.2.1 gave it a timeline. The current study was carried out to estimate the burden of domestic violence (DV) against women and to investigate the sociodemographic correlates of DV victims in India.Methods: Data were drawn from the fifth National Family Health Survey round.

pmc-11499071.title: Radiomics Signatures Based on Computed Tomography for Noninvasive Prediction of CXCL10 Expression and Prognosis in Ovarian Cancer
pmc-11499071.creator: Xiaohua Wang, Yuanyuan Xing, Xuan Zhou, Chunhui Wang, Shuyu Han, Sufen Zhao
pmc-11499071.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer (OC) is an aggressive gynecological tumor usually diagnosed with malignant ascites and even observed widespread metastasis or distant spread.AimsWe aimed to develop and identify radiomics models according to computed tomography (CT) for preoperative prediction of CXCL10 expression and prognosis in patients with OC.

pmc-12605655.title: Deactivation of CK1α enhances the anti-cancer effects of salinomycin in colorectal cancer HCT116 cells
pmc-12605655.creator: Sara Khakshournia, Morvarid Siri, Mozhdeh Zamani, Farzaneh Bozorg-Ghalati, Zahra Mojtahedi, Somayeh Igder, Negar Azarpira, Pooneh Mokarram
pmc-12605655.description: Salinomycin (Sal), an ion-carrier antibiotic, effectively suppresses cancer growth and metastasis through autophagy or ferroptosis induction, thereby overcoming drug resistance. D4476, a selective inhibitor of casein kinase 1 alpha (CK1α), also inhibits the growth of tumors. However, their combined effect on colorectal cancer (CRC) cell growth and the mechanism underlying this effect remain unknown.

pmc-12615715.title: Small cell lung cancer induces synaptic scaling to alter neuronal excitability
pmc-12615715.creator: Aiden J. Houcek, Burak Uzay, Geena V. Ildefonso, Tolu Omokehinde, Lisa M. Monteggia, Vito Quaranta, Amanda Linkous, Ege T. Kavalali
pmc-12615715.description: Tumor cell plasticity in novel microenvironments is central to the integration and subsequent growth of metastatic cells. However, the functional consequences of tumor cell integration with central neurons remains understudied. Here, we address this question using small cell lung cancer (SCLC), which has an extraordinary propensity to metastasize to the brain in humans.

pmc-12625958.title: Exploring evolutionary trajectories of drug resistance
pmc-12625958.creator: Linfeng Hu, Aoxuan Zhang, Arieh Warshel
pmc-12625958.description: SignificanceDrug resistance remains a major obstacle to effective antiviral therapy. Predicting which mutations may arise under drug pressure is key to designing robust treatments. We apply a maximum entropy (MaxEnt) statistical model, which captures evolutionary constraints from sequences, to analyze resistance in viral proteases.

pmc-12734458.title: Process Design of Vinyl-Coated Metal Sheet Stamping for Prevention of Delamination and Wrinkling by DNN-Based Multi-Objective Optimization
pmc-12734458.creator: Min-Gi Kim, Jae-Chang Ryu, Chan-Joo Lee, Jin-Seok Jang, Dae-Cheol Ko, Tomasz Trzepieciński
pmc-12734458.description: The increasing use of vinyl-coated metal (VCM) sheets in home appliances requires robust forming processes to prevent defects such as delamination and wrinkling, especially under elevated temperatures and humidity. This study presents a deep neural network (DNN)-based multi-objective optimization framework to determine optimal stamping parameters for VCM sheets.

pmc-12949827.title: Neutrophil Gelatinase‐Associated Lipocalin and Neutrophil‐to‐Lymphocyte Ratio as Indicators of Nephropathy in Type 2 Diabetic Mellitus Patients in Ghana: A Case‐Control Study
pmc-12949827.creator: Allwell Adofo Ayirebi, Wina Ivy Ofori Boadu, Stephen Twumasi, Samuel Kwarteng, Benedict Sackey, Lilian Antwi Boateng, Joseph Boachie, Samuel Essien‐Baidoo, Daniel Nii Martey Antonio, John Agyemang Sah, Afua Marfowaa, Mayfair Adwapa Mpiani, Joachim Baba Domosie, Abiba Khalifah, Emmanuel Ekow Korsah,
pmc-12949827.description: IntroductionSerum neutrophil gelatinase‐associated lipocalin (sNGAL), a renal tubular marker, and neutrophil‐to‐lymphocyte ratio (NLR), a hematological inflammatory marker are two biomarkers that have recently received attention, because of their association with kidney disease. This study examined the diagnostic value sNGAL and NLR in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients with nephropathy.

pmc-13159377.title: Insights into pig resilience: the Microbiome-genetic connection
pmc-13159377.creator: Enrico Mancin, Cristina Casto-Rebollo, Christian Maltecca, Noelia Ibañez-Escriche, Roberto Mantovani, Cristina Sartori, Francesco Tiezzi
pmc-13159377.description: Animal resilience and the gut microbiota have emerged as two major focus areas in animal science, particularly in swine production. The gut microbiota, as a dynamic and responsive ecosystem, offers unique potential to describe and interpret complex host phenotypes, reflecting genetic and environmental influences and their interplay.

pmc-13249690.title: Effect of case-specific 3D-printed models on surgical performance in cadaveric dissection—a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13249690.creator: Adam Omari, Anders Nøhr, Elissa Suleiman, Per Cayé‑Thomasen, Mads Sølvsten Sørensen, Andreas Frithioff, Steven Arild Wuyts Andersen
pmc-13249690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeTo investigate if training with case-specific 3D-printed temporal bone (TB) models improves trainees’ mastoidectomy performance in cadaveric dissection compared with training on a standard, generic-anatomy 3D-printed TB model.MethodsIn this randomized controlled trial, 22 novice ORL residents performed a cadaveric mastoidectomy with posterior tympanotomy after training two procedures either on 3D-printed TB models of their specific cadaveric bone (CM, n = 11), or on 3D-printed TB with generic anatomy (GM, n = 11). Blinded experts assessed final-product performance using a modified Welling Scale.

pmc-13266802.title: Development and validation of a diagnostic model for malignant pleural effusion based on random forest
pmc-13266802.creator: Xu Guo, Xiao-Lei Wei, Shu-Min Yin, Yu-Peng Li, Kan Zhai, Huan-Zhong Shi, Zheng Wang
pmc-13266802.description: BackgroundThe timely and accurate identification of malignant pleural effusion (MPE) is crucial for prompt treatment. The current diagnostic approaches based on cytology, pathology, or biomarkers have inherent limitations; notably, the drawbacks of single indicators can be overcome by combining various indicators.

pmc-13324803.title: Safety evaluation of the food enzyme triacylglycerol lipase from the genetically modified Trichoderma reesei strain DP‐Nzk118
pmc-13324803.creator: EFSA Panel on Food Enzymes (FEZ), Holger Zorn, José Manuel Barat Baviera, Claudia Bolognesi, Francesco Catania, Gabriele Gadermaier, Ralf Greiner, Baltasar Mayo, Alicja Mortensen, Yrjö Henrik Roos, Marize L. M. Solano, Henk Van Loveren, Laurence Vernis, Cristina Andreoli, Andrea Terron, Andrey Yurko
pmc-13324803.description: The food enzyme triacylglycerol lipase (triacylglycerol acylhydrolase, EC 3.1.1.3) is produced with the genetically modified Trichoderma reesei strain DP‐Nzk118 by Genencor International B.V. The genetic modifications do not give rise to safety concerns. The food enzyme was considered free from viable cells of the production organism and its DNA.

pmc-13415824.title: Recycling pharmaceutical waste (vancomycin) as sustainable corrosion inhibition for API 5 L X60 carbon steel in 1 M hydrochloric acid: a combined electrochemistry and theoretical study
pmc-13415824.creator: Amira A E Satti, Ayman A O Younes, Mai M A H Shanab, Seham Hassan Bashir, Rabeea Mustafa Ali Daoub, Mariem M Motawea, Mohamed E Eissa

pmc-13435905.title: Epidural analgesia during labour in uncomplicated pregnancy low-risk women: intrapartum care and maternal–neonatal outcomes–a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13435905.creator: Simona Fumagalli, Rosemary Turco, Maria Panzeri, Alessandra Moretto, Luca Maria Pietro D’andrea, Antonella Nespoli, Margherita Guglielmetti, Marzia Maini, Anna Locatelli, Sara Ornaghi
pmc-13435905.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the associations between the use of epidural analgesia (EA) and intrapartum care, labour, birth and neonatal outcomes in uncomplicated pregnancy low-risk women, to inform evidence-based intrapartum practices and support informed maternal choice.DesignRetrospective cohort study.SettingSingle maternity hospital in Northern Italy.ParticipantsA total of 3406 uncomplicated pregnancy low-risk women who gave birth between 2019 and 2023 were included.

pmc-13539818.title: Nutritional Management in Cirrhosis and Hepatic Encephalopathy: Current Practices and Expert Opinions of Indian Gastroenterologists
pmc-13539818.creator: Nagaraja R Padaki, Kr Vinayakumar, Jyoti Mohapatra, Akash Roy, Abhishek Banerjee, Karan Kumar, Sourabh B Sonawale, Nandan Joshi
pmc-13539818.description: Background: Chronic liver disease (CLD) is increasingly prevalent in India and is frequently associated with malnutrition, sarcopenia, and hepatic encephalopathy (HE). Although national and international guidelines emphasize adequate nutrition and protein intake, real-world clinical practices in the Indian setting remain insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13577269.title: Assessment of pharmacy professionals’ workplace satisfaction in a conflict-affected health system: evidence from Yemen
pmc-13577269.creator: Najmaddin A H Hatem
pmc-13577269.description: Job satisfaction among pharmacy professionals is a key determinant of workforce retention and quality of pharmaceutical care. Yemen represents an extreme case in which prolonged conflict, economic collapse, and fragmented health governance may fundamentally reshape the professional–organisational relationship. A descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted among pharmacy professionals in Yemen using a self-administered electronic questionnaire.
